limits: This is an instrumented candidate cohort without a matched uninstrumented control. It estimates no optimization gain or instrumentation overhead.
SDK signing includes automated confirmation. First transaction signing includes implicit-account funding inside transaction context.
Signing after unlock excludes the separate unlock call. Unlock timers are harness elapsed values and do not isolate SDK work.
Nested and cross-runtime timings cannot be summed or subtracted to assign exact CPU, transport, SQLite, or durable commit costs.
Zero-only Worker clock spans cannot establish absence of work. Platform CPU and wall observations are separate instruments.
The existing Gateway does not expose the new trace header or nested finalize timing. The temporary Router wrapper joins its Ray ID to a downstream trace.
The three transaction wallets provide a small descriptive sample. No p99 or general target acceptance is established.
Wallet-object colo observations come from the existing outbound Cloudflare trace-page probe. Their mapping to physical execution hosts is unvalidated.
Transaction signatures were independently verified by the harness. Their full signed bytes are not retained for offline re-verification.
The earlier baseline registration failure remains unresolved and is not replaced by these successful diagnostic cases.
